en: Steven
{player}! Good timing. The museum let me hold one of its stones for a moment. Come and look.
text: {player}! Moment bun. Muzeul m-a lăsat să țin o clipă una dintre pietrele lui. Vino să te uiți.

en: Steven held out a smooth, pale stone. Deep inside it, something like an eye seemed to glint.
text: Steven a întins o piatră netedă și palidă. Adânc în ea părea să licărească ceva ca un ochi.

en: Steven
They call it the Enigma Stone. Nobody knows where it came from. But my travelling friend felt it from far away.
text: Îi spun Enigma Stone. Nimeni nu știe de unde vine. Dar prietenul meu de drum a simțit-o de departe.

en: My friend is a Pokémon of the skies over Hoenn. I think it would like to meet you, too.
text: Prietenul meu e un Pokémon al cerului din Hoenn. Cred că ar vrea să te cunoască și pe tine.

en: I'll go and fetch it. Meet us outside, by the houses at the north of the city.
text: Mă duc să-l aduc. Ne vedem afară, lângă casele din nordul orașului.

en: Steven
I gave the Enigma Stone back to the museum. Some stones are meant to be looked at, not kept.
text: Am dat Enigma Stone înapoi muzeului. Unele pietre sunt făcute să fie privite, nu păstrate.

en: Old bones and fallen stars under one roof. I could spend a whole day in here.
text: Oase bătrâne și stele căzute sub același acoperiș. Aș putea petrece o zi întreagă aici.

en: Hoenn's skies are wide, {player}. If you ever cross the sea that way, look up now and then.
text: Cerul Hoenn e larg, {player}. Dacă traversezi vreodată marea într-acolo, uită-te în sus din când în când.

en: Scientist
Welcome to the museum. Mind the bones: some of them are older than the mountains outside.
Oh, you look like a Trainer who travels. We found a lump of amber in the back room, more than we can study.
There's something caught inside it, from long, long ago. My colleague over there can tell you more.
Scientist
We study how to bring Pokémon back from fossils here. And at last, we've managed it!
You've brought a Fossil, haven't you? Shall I bring it back to life for you?
Leave it with me. The machine needs a little while.
Take a walk round Pewter City, then come back. It'll be ready by then.
There you are! Your Fossil came back to life as {thing}!
text: Iată-te! Fosila ta a revenit la viață ca {thing}!

en: {player} received {thing}!
It's been asleep in that stone for longer than anyone can say. Show it the world.
But your team is full! Make room, and come back for it.
text: Dar echipa ta e plină! Fă loc și vino după el.

en: If you ever find a Fossil, bring it here. I'll show you what it used to be!
No? Well, the machine will be here if you change your mind.
text: Nu? Ei bine, aparatul rămâne aici dacă te răzgândești.
